same private data subnets, KMS + force_ssl, Lambdas connect with pg8000 over TLS · one NAT gateway · 1-day backups.
In transit: TLS everywhere (CloudFront, API, S3 denies non-TLS, DB force_ssl). At rest: KMS (DB, uploads, Secrets, Backup), SSE-S3 frontend, SSE-SQS queues.
